readiness_checks.name: Proof Chain Completeness
readiness_checks.requirement: All steps from candidate selection through stability consolidation must be present and traceable.

readiness_checks.name: Operator Typing Integrity
readiness_checks.requirement: All proof-facing operators must preserve declared typed signatures.

readiness_checks.name: Restricted Scope Integrity
readiness_checks.requirement: No proof element may rely on global, universal, or unrestricted continuation.

readiness_checks.name: Failure Preservation Integrity
readiness_checks.requirement: All counterexamples, excluded domains, and blockers remain preserved.

readiness_checks.name: Local Stability Support
readiness_checks.requirement: Only RLSC-STABLE-LOCAL or RLSC-STABLE-WITH-OPEN-BLOCKERS may support readiness.

readiness_checks.name: Theorem Promotion Block
readiness_checks.requirement: Audit may declare readiness for review only, not theorem proof.

readiness_outcomes.meaning: The chain is eligible for formal restricted-local theorem review.
The chain is reviewable, but blockers remain active and must be carried forward.
The chain has unresolved trace, scope, typing, or stability failures.
